RSS 清理完成：删除 %@ 篇文章和 %@ 个本地图片。: RSS cleanup complete: removed %@ articles and %@ local images.
RepoPress 将在 %@ 中创建新的数据文件夹。复制并校验成功后应用会退出: RepoPress will create a new data folder in %@. After the copy is verified, the app will quit. The original folder will not be deleted.
仍有修改未能保存，未更改存储位置。请先解决保存错误。: Some changes could not be saved, so the storage location was not changed. Resolve the save error first.
切换成功后应用会退出。重新打开即可使用新位置；确认无误前请不要删除原文件夹。: The app will quit after switching. Reopen it to use the new location, and keep the original folder until you have verified the new copy.
只清理超过期限、已读、未加入稍后阅读且没有高亮的文章，并一并移除这些文章的本地图: Removes only articles that are older than the limit, read, not saved for later, and have no highlights, together with their local images.
只清空已经移入资料库回收站的内容；仍在资料库中的正文和原始外部文件不会被删除。: Only items already in the library recycle bin are removed. Content still in the library and original external files are not deleted.
回收站中的资料、检索索引和应用内保存的本地副本将被永久删除。此操作无法撤销。: Items in the recycle bin, their search index, and app-managed local copies will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
复制到新位置并切换…: Copy to New Location and Switch…
完整备份包含工作台、资料库、RSS、附件和发布记录；导入前会先校验并显示内容预览: A complete backup includes the workspace, library, RSS, attachments, and publishing history. Imports are verified and previewed first, and API keys are never stored in the backup.
将清理 %@ 天前的已读文章；未读、稍后阅读和带高亮的文章会保留。: Read articles older than %@ days will be removed. Unread, saved-for-later, and highlighted articles will be kept.
当前数据文件夹尚未准备完成。: The current data folder is not ready yet.
当前数据文件夹尚未准备完成，无法更改位置。: The current data folder is not ready, so its location cannot be changed.
数据已复制到 %@，即将退出应用。: Data was copied to %@. The app will now quit.
数据已安全复制到 %@，但应用未能切换到新位置：%@。当前仍使用原文件夹。: Data was safely copied to %@, but the app could not switch to the new location: %@. The original folder remains active.
更改存储位置失败：%@。原文件夹保持不变。: Could not change the storage location: %@. The original folder is unchanged.
正在复制并校验，请勿断开硬盘…: Copying and verifying. Do not disconnect the drive…
没有符合条件的 RSS 历史文章。: No RSS history matched the cleanup rules.
管理资料库与 RSS 的本地文件、备份、导入和存储位置。: Manage local library and RSS files, backups, imports, and storage location.
资料库、RSS 刷新或备份仍在运行，请完成后再更改存储位置。: A library task, RSS refresh, or backup is still running. Change the storage location after it finishes.
资料库清理完成：永久删除 %@ 条资料。: Library cleanup complete: permanently deleted %@ items.
选择本机或外置硬盘中的目标位置。RepoPress 会新建数据文件夹，复制并校验: Choose a location on this Mac or an external drive. RepoPress creates a new data folder and switches only after the entire library, RSS data, and attachments are copied and verified. The original folder is kept.
